arrival_mode.fixed_total_rule: seeded_timing uses int(steps * tasks_per_step * demand_rate + 0.5) tasks per site and varies only bounded arrival placement

condition_definitions.degradation_racs: Same progressive degradation, workload, seed, and trajectory as baseline; RACS predictive drain/cordon enabled with the same hard-failure fallback mechanics.
condition_definitions.degradation_reactive_baseline: Progressive degradation enabled with reactive hard-failure recovery; RACS predictive intervention disabled.
condition_definitions.healthy_control: Same topology, robot count, workload, simulation duration, and seed; progressive degradation disabled; RACS predictive intervention disabled.

metric_definitions.affected_resource_count: 1 when impact remains transport-local; 2 once workstation starvation occurs.
metric_definitions.arrival_sequence_hash: SHA-256 hash of workload_arrivals_by_step. Paired healthy/baseline/RACS rows with the same seed and WIP should match.
metric_definitions.average_completion_latency: Mean completed_step - created_step for completed tasks, in simulation steps. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.cascade_start_delta: RACS degradation-induced cascade start step minus baseline start step for the same seed/WIP when both are defined. Positive means RACS delayed propagation.
metric_definitions.completed_task_delta: RACS completed tasks minus baseline completed tasks for the same seed. Higher is better.
metric_definitions.cumulative_positive_excess_missed_proces: Sum of positive_excess_missed_processing_units_by_step. This is a positive-only event/onset magnitude, not a signed net severity metric.
metric_definitions.degradation_induced_cascade_started: True when cumulative_positive_excess_missed_processing_units is greater than zero.
metric_definitions.detection_lead_time: counterfactual_failure_step - risk_detection_step when both are defined; higher positive values mean earlier detection.
metric_definitions.downstream_completion_deficit_vs_healthy: healthy cumulative downstream completions minus condition cumulative downstream completions at the final step. Positive means the condition is behind healthy.
metric_definitions.downstream_preconditioned_completed: Preconditioned staged units processed by the workstation.
metric_definitions.downstream_tasks_completed: Total units processed by the downstream workstation. Higher is better.
metric_definitions.downstream_transport_completed: AMR-delivered units processed by the workstation.
metric_definitions.final_queue_length: Queued task count at the final simulation step. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.intervention_lead_time: counterfactual_failure_step - intervention_step when both are defined; higher positive values mean earlier intervention.
metric_definitions.intervention_to_baseline_propagation_mar: Baseline degradation-induced cascade start step minus RACS intervention step. Positive means RACS intervened before the downstream propagation seen under baseline.
metric_definitions.late_task_delta: RACS late tasks minus baseline late tasks for the same seed. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.latency_delta: RACS average_completion_latency minus baseline average_completion_latency. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.missed_workstation_processing_units: Raw cumulative workstation processing entitlement not used because delivered input was unavailable. This is not causal attribution by itself.
metric_definitions.net_missed_workstation_processing_defici: Sum of signed_missed_processing_delta_by_step. Positive means the condition lost more workstation opportunities overall than paired healthy; negative means it lost fewer.
metric_definitions.peak_queue_delta: RACS peak_queue_length minus baseline peak_queue_length for the same seed. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.peak_queue_length: Maximum queued task count over simulation steps. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.positive_excess_missed_processing_units_: Per-step max(condition missed workstation processing units - paired healthy missed units, 0). Used for causal downstream-impact onset attribution.
metric_definitions.post_degradation_starvation_start_step: First raw workstation starvation step at or after degradation_start_step, else None.
metric_definitions.post_degradation_starvation_started: Raw indicator that workstation starvation occurred at or after degradation_start_step. This is timing-based and not causal attribution by itself.
metric_definitions.post_degradation_starvation_steps: Raw count of workstation starvation steps at or after degradation_start_step. Steps may be non-contiguous. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.preconditioned_workstation_units: Units staged into the workstation buffer at degradation_start_step by scenario preconditioning.
metric_definitions.queue_auc: Sum of queued task count over simulation steps. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.queue_auc_delta: RACS queue_auc minus baseline queue_auc for the same seed. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.robot_utilization_summary: Mean, min, and max of per-robot busy_steps / elapsed_steps at the final step.
metric_definitions.signed_missed_processing_delta_by_step: Per-step condition missed workstation processing units minus paired healthy missed units. Negative values are preserved.
metric_definitions.tasks_completed: Total tasks with COMPLETED status by the final simulation step. Higher is better.
metric_definitions.tasks_completed_delta: Alias for completed_task_delta. RACS completed tasks minus baseline completed tasks for the same seed. Higher is better.
metric_definitions.tasks_created: Total SimTask objects created by the final simulation step.
metric_definitions.tasks_failed: Total tasks with FAILED status. The V1 simulator does not yet model timeout failure, so this is expected to remain zero unless failure semantics are added.
metric_definitions.tasks_late: Completed tasks whose completed_step is greater than deadline_step. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.throughput_degradation: (healthy.completed - condition.completed) / healthy.completed; None if healthy.completed is zero. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.throughput_degradation_delta: RACS throughput_degradation minus baseline throughput_degradation. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.transport_delivered_to_workstation: Transport-completed AMR tasks deposited into the workstation input buffer during the run.
metric_definitions.unfinished_tasks_at_end: tasks_created - tasks_completed - tasks_failed at the final step. Lower is better.
metric_definitions.workload_arrivals_by_step: Pure exogenous task arrivals per simulation step, excluding fault shocks and non-RACS cascade-created tasks.
metric_definitions.workstation_buffer_auc: Sum of workstation input-buffer units over simulation steps. Interpretation is scenario-dependent.
metric_definitions.workstation_starvation_step_sequence: Exact simulation steps where raw workstation starvation occurred.
metric_definitions.workstation_starvation_steps: Steps where the enabled workstation had integer processing entitlement but insufficient delivered input after startup eligibility. Lower is better.

racs_policy.policy_note: V1 policy parameters are explicit and reproducible; they are not claimed to be proven-optimal calibration.
